results.name: Flood in  Sri Lanka
results.reason: On the 27 November 2025,  Tropical Cyclone DITWAH-25 formed over Sri Lanka. The event caused heavy damage across the country, with floods, landslides and mudslides reported. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
